summary.ja: 共通基盤として連鎖律・前進／逆モード・JVPを学び、同じBratu方程式で解析微分・有限差分・前進モード自動微分を検証する。
summary.en: A shared foundation for the chain rule, forward/reverse modes and JVPs, with analytic, finite-difference and forward-AD verification on the same Bratu equation.

next_deliverable.ja: 逆モードとHessian–vector積の独立した実行検証。陰関数微分・随伴法は専用のBratu感度章を参照。
next_deliverable.en: Separate executable checks for reverse mode and Hessian-vector products. Implicit differentiation and adjoints now have a separate Bratu sensitivity chapter.

limitations.ja: 教育用の実数前進モードとBratuの小規模密行列Newton比較に限定。逆モード、HVP、行列不要Newton–Krylovは解説のみ。陰関数微分・随伴法の実行検証は別の専用配布版で扱う。
limitations.en: Limited to educational real forward mode and small dense-Newton Bratu comparisons. Reverse mode, HVPs and matrix-free Newton–Krylov remain explanatory only. A separate dedicated supplement verifies implicit sensitivities and discrete adjoints.

metadata_review.level: scoped forward-mode implementation; analytic/finite-difference/AD derivatives and Bratu refinement checked

code_mapping_scope: Supplemental immutable AD edition; the original general code edition is unchanged. One residual and the existing Armijo-damped Newton solver; analytic Jacobian, coordinate finite differences and seeded dual-number Jacobian. Eight dedicated tests.
